familySummary: Bacoli sideboards bring a natural oak look to a practical storage piece for dining or living spaces.
familyDescription: The Bacoli family is defined by a natural oak appearance and a clean sideboard profile suited to dining rooms, living areas, or hallways. It offers a straightforward way to store and organise everyday items while keeping the room visually calm. This range includes the Bacoli Sideboard at 180 × 45 × 70 cm. It is made from Particle board, MDF, Melamine, Plywood, and Wood veneer.
